    "stilllife": "still life fruit flowers watercolor painting",
    "birch": "birch forest trees watercolor painting",
    "cathedral": "cathedral church building watercolor painting",
    "bridge": "bridge river watercolor painting",
    "street": "old town street watercolor painting",
    "generic": "landscape watercolor painting",
}

KEYWORD_MAP = [
    (r"talvi|lumi|pakkas", "winter"),
    (r"kes[aä]|kukk", "summer"),
    (r"syks|marras", "autumn"),
    (r"kev[aä]t|kevää", "spring"),
    (r"ilta|y[oö]n", "evening"),
    (r"aamu", "morning"),
    (r"sade|sateen", "rain"),
    (r"myrsky", "storm"),
    (r"meri|ranta|satama|telakka|silakka", "sea"),
    (r"tori", "market"),
    (r"asetelma|hedelm", "stilllife"),
    (r"koivu", "birch"),
    (r"katedraali", "cathedral"),
    (r"silla|sillalla", "bridge"),
    (r"katu|kadu", "street"),
]


def bucket_for(alt):
    low = alt.lower()
    for pattern, bucket in KEYWORD_MAP:
        if re.search(pattern, low):
            return bucket
    return "generic"


def api_get(params, retries=6):
    url = "https://commons.wikimedia.org/w/api.php?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    delay = 3
    for attempt in range(retries):
        try:
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                return json.loads(resp.read())
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code == 429 and attempt < retries - 1:
                wait = e.headers.get("Retry-After")
                wait = int(wait) if wait and wait.isdigit() else delay
                print(f"  429, sleeping {wait}s (attempt {attempt+1}/{retries})")
                time.sleep(wait)
                delay = min(delay * 2, 30)
                continue
            print(f"  HTTPError {e.code}, giving up on this call")
            return None
        except (urllib.error.URLError, TimeoutError, ConnectionError, OSError) as e:
            if attempt < retries - 1:
                print(f"  network error ({e}), retrying in {delay}s (attempt {attempt+1}/{retries})")
                time.sleep(delay)
                delay = min(delay * 2, 30)
                continue
            print(f"  network error ({e}), giving up on this call")
            return None
    return None


def search_commons(query, limit=25):
    data = api_get(
        {
            "action": "query",
            "format": "json",
            "list": "search",
            "srnamespace": "6",
            "srsearch": query,
            "srlimit": str(limit),
        }
    )
    return [item["title"] for item in data.get("query", {}).get("search", [])] if data else []


def batch_imageinfo(titles):
    """Fetch imageinfo for up to 50 titles per call - drastically fewer requests than one-by-one."""
    info = {}
    chunk = 50
    for i in range(0, len(titles), chunk):
        batch = titles[i : i + chunk]
        data = api_get(
            {
                "action": "query",
                "format": "json",
                "prop": "imageinfo",
                "iiprop": "url|mime|size",
                "titles": "|".join(batch),
            }
        )
        time.sleep(1.2)
        if not data:
            continue
        pages = data.get("query", {}).get("pages", {})
        for page in pages.values():
            title = page.get("title")
            infos = page.get("imageinfo")
            if title and infos:
                info[title] = infos[0]
    return info


def looks_like_image(data):
    if not data or len(data) < 16:
        return False
    head = data[:16]
    sigs = [b"\xff\xd8\xff", b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", b"GIF87a", b"GIF89a", b"RIFF", b"BM"]
    return any(head.startswith(s) for s in sigs)


def main():
    slots = json.loads(SLOTS_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    print(f"slots: {len(slots)}")

    pools = {}
    for bucket, query in BUCKETS.items():
        try:
            titles = search_commons(query, limit=25)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"search failed for {bucket}: {e}")
            titles = []
        pools[bucket] = titles
        print(f"bucket {bucket}: {len(titles)} candidates")
        time.sleep(1.2)

    all_titles = sorted({t for titles in pools.values() for t in titles})
    print(f"fetching imageinfo for {len(all_titles)} unique titles in batches...")
    info_map = batch_imageinfo(all_titles)
    print(f"got imageinfo for {len(info_map)} titles")

    used_titles = set()
    log = []

    for slot in slots:
        alt = slot["alt"]
        bucket = bucket_for(alt)
        candidates = pools.get(bucket, []) + pools["generic"]
        chosen_title, chosen_url = None, None
        for title in candidates:
            if title in used_titles:
                continue
            info = info_map.get(title)
            if not info:
                continue
            if info.get("size", 0) and info["size"] > 15_000_000:
                continue
            if info.get("mime", "") not in ("image/jpeg", "image/png"):
                continue
            chosen_title, chosen_url = title, info["url"]
            break

        if not chosen_url:
            log.append({"alt": alt, "bucket": bucket, "status": "NO_CANDIDATE"})
            print(f"[MISS] {alt} ({bucket}) - no candidate found")
            continue

        img_bytes = None
        last_err = None
        for attempt in range(3):
            try:
                req = urllib.request.Request(chosen_url, headers=UA)
                with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                    img_bytes = resp.read()
                break
            except Exception as e:
                last_err = e
                time.sleep(3)
        if img_bytes is None:
            log.append({"alt": alt, "bucket": bucket, "status": f"DOWNLOAD_FAIL: {last_err}"})
            print(f"[FAIL] {alt}: {last_err}")
            continue

        if not looks_like_image(img_bytes):
            log.append({"alt": alt, "bucket": bucket, "status": "NOT_AN_IMAGE"})
            print(f"[BAD]  {alt}: downloaded content not an image")
            continue

        used_titles.add(chosen_title)
        for local in slot["locals"]:
            local_path = (SITE_DIR / local).resolve()
            local_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            local_path.write_bytes(img_bytes)

        log.append(
            {
                "alt": alt,
                "bucket": bucket,
                "status": "OK",
                "commons_title": chosen_title,
                "url": chosen_url,
                "locals": slot["locals"],
            }
        )
        print(f"[OK]   {alt} ({bucket}) <- {chosen_title}")
        time.sleep(0.4)

    LOG_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(log, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    ok = sum(1 for x in log if x["status"] == "OK")
    print(f"\ndone: {ok}/{len(slots)} slots filled. Log: {LOG_PATH}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import re

    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=15) as resp:

    return data.get("results", [])[:count]

    url = "https://duckduckgo.com/?q=" + urllib.parse.quote(query) + "&iar=images&iax=images&ia=images"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    with opener.open(req, timeout=15) as resp:
        html = resp.read().decode("utf-8", errors="ignore")
    m = re.search(r'vqd=([\d-]+)', html)
    return m.group(1) if m else None

def search_images(query, vqd, count=10):
    params = {"l": "us-en", "o": "json", "q": query, "vqd": vqd, "f": ",,,", "p": "-1"}
    url = "https://duckduckgo.com/i.js?" + urllib.parse.urlencode(params)
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
    with opener.open(req, timeout=15) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read())
    return data.get("results", [])[:count]

vqd = get_vqd("watercolor painting landscape")

# -*- coding: utf-8 -*-
import json
import re
import sys
import time
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

for _stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
    if hasattr(_stream, "reconfigure"):
        _stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")

SITE_DIR = Path(r"d:\000\LOOOOOOOOL\01JOB\www.mikatoronen.com")
BASE = Path(
    r"E:\01JOPA\temp1\claude\d--000-LOOOOOOOOL-01JOB-www-mikatoronen-com\379751bd-ae59-491f-93a9-01a7759f6ebd\scratchpad"
)
SLOTS_PATH = BASE / "slots.json"
POOL_PATH = BASE / "pexels_pool.json"
LOG_PATH = BASE / "fill_log.json"

UA = {"User-Agent": "Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36"}

KEYWORD_MAP = [
    (r"talvi|lumi|pakkas", "winter"),
    (r"kes[aä]|kukk", "summer"),
    (r"syks|marras", "autumn"),
    (r"kev[aä]t|kevää", "spring"),
    (r"ilta|y[oö]n", "evening"),
    (r"aamu", "morning"),
    (r"sade|sateen", "rain"),
    (r"myrsky", "storm"),
    (r"meri|ranta|satama|telakka|silakka", "sea"),
    (r"tori", "market"),
    (r"asetelma|hedelm", "stilllife"),
    (r"koivu", "birch"),
    (r"katedraali", "cathedral"),
    (r"silla|sillalla", "bridge"),
    (r"katu|kadu", "street"),
]


def bucket_for(alt):
    low = alt.lower()
    for pattern, bucket in KEYWORD_MAP:
        if re.search(pattern, low):
            return bucket
    return "generic"


def looks_like_image(data):
    if not data or len(data) < 16:
        return False
    head = data[:16]
    sigs = [b"\xff\xd8\xff", b"\x89PNG\r\n\x1a\n", b"GIF87a", b"GIF89a", b"RIFF", b"BM"]
    return any(head.startswith(s) for s in sigs)


def already_filled(slot):
    for local in slot["locals"]:
        p = (SITE_DIR / local).resolve()
        if not p.is_file():
            return False
        head = p.read_bytes()[:16]
        if not looks_like_image(head):
            return False
    return True


def download(url, retries=3):
    for attempt in range(retries):
        try:
            req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers=UA)
            with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as resp:
                return resp.read()
        except Exception as e:
            if attempt == retries - 1:
                raise
            time.sleep(2)


def main():
    slots = json.loads(SLOTS_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    pool = json.loads(POOL_PATH.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    for bucket in pool:
        pool[bucket] = list(pool[bucket])  # local mutable copy

    used_urls = set()
    log = []
    skipped, filled, failed = 0, 0, 0

    for slot in slots:
        alt = slot["alt"]
        if already_filled(slot):
            skipped += 1
            log.append({"alt": alt, "status": "SKIP_ALREADY_FILLED"})
            print(f"[SKIP] {alt} - already has a valid image")
            continue

        bucket = bucket_for(alt)
        candidates = pool.get(bucket, []) + pool["generic"]
        chosen_url = None
        for url in candidates:
            if url not in used_urls:
                chosen_url = url
                break
        if not chosen_url:
            # bucket + generic exhausted -> pull from any bucket
            for b_urls in pool.values():
                for url in b_urls:
                    if url not in used_urls:
                        chosen_url = url
                        break
                if chosen_url:
                    break

        if not chosen_url:
            failed += 1
            log.append({"alt": alt, "bucket": bucket, "status": "POOL_EXHAUSTED"})
            print(f"[FAIL] {alt} ({bucket}) - pool exhausted")
            continue

        try:
            data = download(chosen_url)
        except Exception as e:
            failed += 1
            log.append({"alt": alt, "bucket": bucket, "status": f"DOWNLOAD_FAIL: {e}"})
            print(f"[FAIL] {alt}: {e}")
            continue

        if not looks_like_image(data):
            failed += 1
            log.append({"alt": alt, "bucket": bucket, "status": "NOT_AN_IMAGE"})
            print(f"[BAD]  {alt}: not an image")
            continue

        used_urls.add(chosen_url)
        for local in slot["locals"]:
            local_path = (SITE_DIR / local).resolve()
            local_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            local_path.write_bytes(data)

        filled += 1
        log.append({"alt": alt, "bucket": bucket, "status": "OK", "url": chosen_url, "locals": slot["locals"]})
        print(f"[OK]   {alt} ({bucket}) <- {chosen_url}")
        LOG_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(log, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        time.sleep(0.15)

    LOG_PATH.write_text(json.dumps(log, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(f"\ndone. skipped(already ok)={skipped} filled={filled} failed={failed} total={len(slots)}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

def ensure_local_seo_files(html_path, site_domain, report, dry_run=False):
    """PBN checklist items 39/40: robots.txt and sitemap.xml must exist. Archivarix
    normally generates these; a plain wayback/browser export never does - so create
    them ourselves if missing, rather than just flagging the gap."""
    site_root = html_path.parent
    robots_path = site_root / "robots.txt"
    sitemap_path = site_root / "sitemap.xml"
    report.robots_present = robots_path.is_file()
    report.sitemap_present = sitemap_path.is_file()

    if dry_run:
        return

    domain = site_domain or "example.com"

    if not report.robots_present:
        robots_path.write_text(
            f"User-agent: *\nAllow: /\n\nSitemap: https://{domain}/sitemap.xml\n", encoding="utf-8"
        )
        report.robots_present = True
        report.robots_created = True

    if not report.sitemap_present:
        html_files = sorted(site_root.rglob("*.html"))
        urls = []
        for f in html_files:
            rel = f.relative_to(site_root).as_posix()
            loc = f"https://{domain}/" if rel == "index.html" else f"https://{domain}/{rel}"
            urls.append(loc)
        entries = "\n".join(f"  <url><loc>{u}</loc></url>" for u in urls)
        xml = (
            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
            '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n'
            f"{entries}\n"
            "</urlset>\n"
        )
        sitemap_path.write_text(xml, encoding="utf-8")
        report.sitemap_present = True
        report.sitemap_created = True


def check_canonical_domain(soup, site_domain, report):
    canonical = soup.find("link", rel="canonical")
    if canonical and canonical.get("href") and site_domain:
        d = domain_of(canonical["href"])
        if d and not matches_suffix(d, {site_domain}):
            report.canonical_domain_mismatch = canonical["href"]


def check_and_fix_noindex(soup, report):
    """PBN checklist item 41: important pages must not be blocked from indexing."""
    tag = soup.find("meta", attrs={"name": re.compile("^robots$", re.I)})
    if tag and tag.get("content") and "noindex" in tag["content"].lower():
        report.noindex_removed = tag["content"]
        tag.decompose()


JS_REDIRECT_RE = re.compile(
    r"(?:window\.location(?:\.href)?|top\.location|document\.location)\s*=\s*['\"]([^'\"]+)['\"]"
)


def check_and_fix_redirect(soup, site_domain, report):
    """PBN checklist item 4: no redirect to an external domain (meta-refresh or JS)."""
    meta = soup.find("meta", attrs={"http-equiv": re.compile("^refresh$", re.I)})

def ensure_local_seo_files(html_path, site_domain, report, dry_run=False):
    """PBN checklist items 39/40: robots.txt and sitemap.xml must exist. Archivarix
    normally generates these; a plain wayback/browser export never does - so create
    them ourselves if missing, rather than just flagging the gap."""
    site_root = html_path.parent
    robots_path = site_root / "robots.txt"
    sitemap_path = site_root / "sitemap.xml"
    report.robots_present = robots_path.is_file()
    report.sitemap_present = sitemap_path.is_file()

    if dry_run:
        return

    domain = site_domain or "example.com"

    if not report.robots_present:
        robots_path.write_text(
            f"User-agent: *\nAllow: /\n\nSitemap: https://{domain}/sitemap.xml\n", encoding="utf-8"
        )
        report.robots_present = True
        report.robots_created = True

    if not report.sitemap_present:
        html_files = sorted(site_root.rglob("*.html"))
        urls = []
        for f in html_files:
            rel = f.relative_to(site_root).as_posix()
            loc = f"https://{domain}/" if rel == "index.html" else f"https://{domain}/{rel}"
            urls.append(loc)
        entries = "\n".join(f"  <url><loc>{u}</loc></url>" for u in urls)
        xml = (
            '<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>\n'
            '<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9">\n'
            f"{entries}\n"
            "</urlset>\n"
        )
        sitemap_path.write_text(xml, encoding="utf-8")
        report.sitemap_present = True
        report.sitemap_created = True

**1. Дыры по чек-листу — нашёл и залатал.** Перечитал документ полностью, сверил пункт за пунктом с тем, что скрипт реально делает. Добавил в `clean_wayback_site.py`:

- Проверка/удаление **noindex-метки** (пункт 41 — "важные страницы не закрыты от индексации").
- Проверка/удаление **редиректа на внешний домен** (meta-refresh и `window.location`-джаваскрипт) — пункт 4, раньше вообще не проверялось.

Это теперь явно попадает в отчёт как MEDIUM — я не стал это тихо "чинить" выдумыванием несуществующих страниц, честно показываю проблему.
- Флаг `--domain` — задать целевой домен для robots/sitemap отдельно от того, что определилось автоматически.

**2. Site Studio — mini-GUI с живым превью.** `D:\000\LOOOOOOOOL\01JOB\scriptArchive\site_studio\` — `python server.py <папка_сайта>`, открывается `http://127.0.0.1:5151`. Слева панель: путь к сайту, поле шрифта (пишешь "Jost:wght@400;700" → применяется), поиск картинок (запрос + CSS-селектор родителя + сколько скачать + выбор источника). Справа — сам сайт живьём в iframe, обновляется после каждого применения.

Важная техническая правда, которую надо знать: **прямой скрапинг Google/Pexels картинок не работает** — проверил конкретно, оба варианта блокируются антибот-защитой (403) при обычном запросе, даже с полными браузерными заголовками. Ключи вводятся один раз в разделе "Настройки провайдеров" в самом интерфейсе и сохраняются в папке сайта.

Логику "родительский класс → находит детей с картинками → вставляет" протестировал на реальной структуре сайта: селектор `.thumb` нашёл все 71 слот галереи, картинки распределяются по кругу если их меньше чем слотов. def _ensure_pillow():
    try:
        import PIL  # noqa: F401
    except ImportError:
        print("[setup] installing missing dependency: Pillow ...")
        subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-q", "Pillow"])
        import importlib

def _letter_to_bg_color(letter):
    """Deterministic (same letter -> same color every run) but varied background."""
    import colorsys
    import hashlib

    digest = hashlib.md5(letter.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    hue = (int(digest[:8], 16) % 360) / 360.0
    r, g, b = colorsys.hls_to_rgb(hue, 0.42, 0.55)
    return (int(r * 255), int(g * 255), int(b * 255))


def _generate_default_favicon(dest_path, letter):
    """No branding assets to work with yet - draw a simple flat-color monogram icon
    (first letter of the site/brand name) instead of leaving no favicon at all."""
    _ensure_pillow()
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

    size = 256
    bg = _letter_to_bg_color(letter)
    img = Image.new("RGB", (size, size), bg)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    font = None
    for candidate in ("seguisb.ttf", "arialbd.ttf", "DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", "arial.ttf"):
        try:
            font = ImageFont.truetype(candidate, int(size * 0.6))
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    if font is None:
        font = ImageFont.load_default()

    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), letter, font=font)

def _letter_to_bg_color(letter):
    """Deterministic (same letter -> same color every run) but varied background."""
    import colorsys
    import hashlib

    digest = hashlib.md5(letter.encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()
    hue = (int(digest[:8], 16) % 360) / 360.0
    r, g, b = colorsys.hls_to_rgb(hue, 0.42, 0.55)
    return (int(r * 255), int(g * 255), int(b * 255))


def _generate_default_favicon(dest_path, letter):
    """No branding assets to work with yet - draw a simple flat-color monogram icon
    (first letter of the site/brand name) instead of leaving no favicon at all."""
    _ensure_pillow()
    from PIL import Image, ImageDraw, ImageFont

    size = 256
    bg = _letter_to_bg_color(letter)
    img = Image.new("RGB", (size, size), bg)
    draw = ImageDraw.Draw(img)

    font = None
    for candidate in ("seguisb.ttf", "arialbd.ttf", "DejaVuSans-Bold.ttf", "arial.ttf"):
        try:
            font = ImageFont.truetype(candidate, int(size * 0.6))
            break
        except Exception:
            continue
    if font is None:
        font = ImageFont.load_default()

    bbox = draw.textbbox((0, 0), letter, font=font)
    w, h = bbox[2] - bbox[0], bbox[3] - bbox[1]
    draw.text(((size - w) / 2 - bbox[0], (size - h) / 2 - bbox[1]), letter, font=font, fill="white")

def _primary_font_family(fonts_param):
    """"Jost:wght@400;700,Inter" -> "Jost" - the family name typed in, GF API params
    stripped off, first family only (that's the one meant to actually apply site-wide)."""
    first = fonts_param.split(",")[0].strip()

def inject_google_fonts(soup, fonts_param):
    head = soup.find("head")
    if not head:
        return

    for tag in head.find_all(attrs={"data-site-studio-font": True}):
        tag.decompose()

    preconnect1 = soup.new_tag("link", rel="preconnect", href="https://fonts.googleapis.com")
    preconnect1["data-site-studio-font"] = "link"
    preconnect2 = soup.new_tag("link", rel="preconnect", href="https://fonts.gstatic.com")
    preconnect2["crossorigin"] = ""
    preconnect2["data-site-studio-font"] = "link"
    families = "&".join(f"family={fam.strip()}" for fam in fonts_param.split(",") if fam.strip())
    font_link = soup.new_tag(
        "link", rel="stylesheet", href=f"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?{families}&display=swap"
    )
    font_link["data-site-studio-font"] = "link"
    head.append(preconnect1)
    head.append(preconnect2)
    head.append(font_link)

    # Loading the font isn't enough - the site's own CSS still references whatever
    # font-family the original theme used, so nothing would actually render in the
    # new font without a global override.
    primary = _primary_font_family(fonts_param)
    if primary:
        force_style = soup.new_tag("style")
        force_style["data-site-studio-font"] = "force"
        force_style.string = f"* {{ font-family: '{primary}', sans-serif !important; }}"
        head.append(force_style)

def apply_font(html_path, family_param):
    """family_param e.g. "Jost:wght@400;500;600;700" or "Jost:wght@400;700,Inter" """
    soup = _read_soup(html_path)
    head = soup.find("head")
    if not head:
        raise ValueError("this file has no <head>")

    # Remove any existing Google Fonts links, whether they carry our marker (from a
    # previous site_studio apply) or not (e.g. injected earlier by clean_wayback_site.py)
    # - the intent of "apply a font" is to replace whatever is currently set.
    for link in list(head.find_all("link")):
        href = link.get("href", "")
        if "fonts.googleapis.com" in href or "fonts.gstatic.com" in href:
            link.decompose()

    preconnect1 = soup.new_tag("link", rel="preconnect", href="https://fonts.googleapis.com")
    preconnect1["data-site-studio"] = FONT_MARKER
    preconnect2 = soup.new_tag("link", rel="preconnect", href="https://fonts.gstatic.com")
    preconnect2["crossorigin"] = ""
    preconnect2["data-site-studio"] = FONT_MARKER
    families = "&".join(f"family={f.strip()}" for f in family_param.split(",") if f.strip())
    font_link = soup.new_tag(
        "link", rel="stylesheet", href=f"https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?{families}&display=swap"
    )
    font_link["data-site-studio"] = FONT_MARKER

    head.append(preconnect1)

## Итог

**Добавлено в скрипт (оба места — `clean_wayback_site.py` и GUI `site_studio`):** какой шрифт ни укажешь, теперь помимо подключения через Google Fonts `<link>` автоматически добавляется:
```html
<style>* { font-family: 'Jost', sans-serif !important; }</style>
```
— именно то, о чём ты просил, потому что просто подключить шрифт через `<link>` недостаточно: сайт всё равно рендерился бы старым шрифтом (proxima-nova/futura-pt), пока CSS страницы не переопределён.

Попутно поймал и починил баг: маркер-атрибут для идемпотентности (`data-site-studio-font`) на этом style-теге терялся, потому что чистка `data-*` атрибутов в пайплайне шла позже вставки шрифта — переставил порядок.

Применил к реальному проекту — сейчас на mikatoronen.com весь текст рендерится Jost'ом через `!important`-override, фавикон и лого на месте, картинки целы (141/141).
